title: Export discriminant and feature-ranking results
description: You inspect the array archive and the readable evaluation summary.

steps.description: You create artifacts and save raw data, split arrays, projection directions, eigenvalues, and projected observations. The archive names each stored array.
You also save the classifier's means, covariance, and priors. Fisher scores and their ranking order appear as separate archive entries.

steps.question: Does the JSON ranking contain feature indices or feature names?
steps.answer: It looks up feature_names[j] for each index in order, so the JSON ranking contains names.

steps.description: You write accuracy, the test confusion matrix, ranking names, and eigenvalues to summary.json. The recorded directory listing contains that summary and lda_fisher_from_scratch.npz.
